title: Cymatics experiment in the King's Chamber produces the Eye of Horus

tellings.quote: actually um did some experiments alongside some other scientists in the king's chamber where they they stretched a membrane uh over the uh sarcophagus of the king's chamber like a cladney plate like a simatic plate and they put Egyptian sand on the plate and they sent vibrational frequencies that match the the frequency of the king's chamber through it and it turned into the eye of Horus.

plain: Scientists inside the King's Chamber of the Great Pyramid in Egypt are said to have stretched a membrane over the stone sarcophagus there, like a plate on which sand forms patterns when sound passes through it. They scattered Egyptian sand on it, played sound at the chamber's own frequency, and the sand formed the Eye of Horus, the ancient Egyptian symbol. A guest named Jay Anderson tells this on the show as something done by a man named David Elkington and other scientists, and the point would be that the pyramid was built with its sound in mind.
